title: UMRC Bridge Chat: Proposal to End the GMD Warning at 0715 UTC

fields.topic: UMRC GMD level: EMERGENCY — serial UMRC-GMD-2027-033 — next call 02:15 CDT (0715 UTC)

messages.text: @UMRC Shift Manager, cc all TOPs: WARK05 expired at 0600 UTC (01:00 CDT), and SWPC has no active geomagnetic warning. Estimated Kp has been 4, 3, 3 since 23:00 CDT, so three hours at Kp 4 or lower. I propose we end the GMD warning on the 02:15 call and send termination at 0715 UTC. Please get each TOP's agreement on the bridge.

GIC NEUTRAL CURRENT TREND, 22:30–01:50 CDT (10 s scan, hourly max shown)
22:30–23:30 HARTLEY_AT1_GIC_NEUT max 14 A | all others < 12 A
23:30–00:30 HARTLEY_AT1_GIC_NEUT max 21 A | all others < 12 A
00:35:10 HARTLEY_AT1_GIC_NEUT 29 A
00:36:00 HARTLEY_AT1_GIC_NEUT 18 A
00:36–01:50 HARTLEY_AT1_GIC_NEUT max 16 A
IRON_RANGE_AT1/AT3, HARTLEY_AT2, CLOQUET_AT1/AT2, NORTH_SHORE_AT1, VIRGINIA_AT1: < 12 A since 22:30
IRON_RANGE_AT2 DGA GAS ALARM (H2): LATCHED since 17:46:50, not reset
Superior Range agrees with termination at 0715Z. Our neutrals have been under 10 A since about 22:00, and our capacitor banks come out at 02:30.
+1 from Red River. All quiet here since midnight.
Lakeshore is OK with it in principle. Our bank that hit 160 A is still on DGA watch, so we will check it before it goes back to normal loading. LPC-0309-345-07 is back in service as of 18:05.

Thanks. Superior Range, Red River and Lakeshore have answered. NLTO, I need your agreement or your objection before the 02:15 call so the termination notice can go out on time. Every TOP will have to confirm on the call how many of its own entities it told.

instructorNote: Termination pressure inject: three TOPs have already agreed, but NLTO's own termination conditions (NGDOP 8) are not met. Hartley AT1 was at 29 A at 00:35, so the 3 hours below 25 A only began at 00:36 and run until about 03:36. Watch whether the CRSS objects or asks for a later time instead of going along with the others, whether the RCSM checks each condition and asks every TOP before ending the warning, and whether the RE flags the latched Iron Range T2 gas alarm for review before T2 is restored.
